text: At its meeting held on May 21 and 22, 2025, City Council appointed the following members to the Board of Directors of TO Live for a term of office from May 23, 2025, to May 24, 2029, and until successors are appointed: Brett Hendrie Michael Herrera Sammy Lau These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Owais Lightwala who resigned on January 27, 2025 and Mustafa Humayun and Myriam Gafarou whose terms of office came to an end on May 22, 2025.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
